governance.ceo_comp_source: 20-F FY2024 (Item 6.B Compensation, aggregate director & exec officer comp disclosed in aggregate per HK/Cayman practice; estimate for CEO portion)
governance.ceo_comp_note: Futu is a Cayman-incorporated issuer listed on Nasdaq, reports on Form 20-F. Unlike US domestic SCT, executive compensation is disclosed in aggregate for directors and senior management; individual CEO comp is not separately broken out. Figure is best-effort estimate based on aggregate disclosure and reported share-based awards to founder/CEO.
